subject: Testimonial excerpt + limited logo license — MSA publicity carveout request
messages:
From: Taylor Shaw <taylor@fastai.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal@fastai.io
Date: 2026-11-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: short testimonial + logo use for pilot announcement

Connor — great kickoff call this morning, thanks.

FastAI would like to include a one-sentence testimonial and our logo on a private pilot announcement page (not a public press release) to help with partner outreach. The ask is narrow: one 20–25 word excerpt pulled from our product team quote, plus usage of the FastAI logo in a 300x150px slot on a partner page for up to 6 months.

Can Redwood confirm:
- Is this covered by the MSA publicity/reference section, or do we need a carveout?
- Any standard language you prefer for testimonial approval window or required attribution?
- We can sign an addendum or annotate the Order Form. Attached is the draft testimonial and a screenshot of the placement.

Thanks — happy to loop in our counsel if that helps.

— Taylor
Taylor Shaw
Head of Partnerships, FastAI Labs
Attachment: Testimonial_Draft_v3.docx (docx)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Taylor Shaw <taylor@fastai.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T08:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: short testimonial + logo use for pilot announcement

Thanks Taylor — appreciate the clear scope. Quick answers up front: we generally allow customer quotes and logo use with a short approval window, but the standard MSA publicity clause assumes both parties opt in via the Order Form. Given this is a pilot and you specified a partner page (not press), we can do a limited carveout via Order Form annotation rather than changing the full MSA.

I've attached a short note with suggested language and practical constraints (size/placement, attribution, and a 7-business-day approval window for testimonial edits). Marissa is on copy to review any legal redlines.

Proposed next steps:
- Marissa: quick redline of the publicity paragraph + a one-paragraph addendum we can attach to the Order Form.
- Taylor: if you can confirm the exact asset (logo file and final quote) we'll include that in the addendum.
- I'll prepare a DocuSign for signatures if counsel agrees.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Connors_Publicity_Suggestions_20261110.txt (txt)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Taylor Shaw <taylor@fastai.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: short testimonial + logo use for pilot announcement

Taylor / Connor — thanks for the context. I reviewed the draft and propose the following high-level approach to keep liability and publicity scope tightly bound: 

1) Limited publicity carveout: add an Order Form Addendum that permits Redwood to use the specified testimonial excerpt and FastAI logo only as set forth in the addendum. No broader MSA amendment.
2) Approval mechanics: FastAI provides a single final quote and logo asset; Redwood will submit the exact rendering for approval. FastAI has 7 business days to approve proposed use; silence = approval only if you confirm that in writing.
3) Scope & timeframe: usage limited to the pilot partner page and Redwood marketing collaterals promoting the pilot to partners; duration 6 months from the Effective Date on the Order Form unless otherwise agreed.
4) Attribution and trademark: include required trademark notice text and a single allowed logo variant (color or monochrome) with maximum pixel area 300x150. No co-branding on press releases or public-facing press pages without separate written consent.
4) Confidentiality carveout minimal wording: public attribution limited to the approved excerpt; all other information remains Confidential under Section 5 of the MSA.
5) Escalation & takedown: FastAI can request takedown within 48 hours for legal or regulatory reasons; Redwood will remove within 48 hours of request.

I've drafted redline language for the MSA publicity paragraph and a short addendum. See attached PDF with inline edits (MSA_OrderForm_Redline_20261109.pdf). Two points for Connor/Marketing: we should avoid including any raw usage metrics or quotes that reveal contract terms.

If that approach works for FastAI, I can convert the addendum to a DocuSign-ready form. If FastAI counsel asks for different timing or broader rights, please send annotated redlines.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: MSA_OrderForm_Redline_20261109.pdf (pdf)

From: Elena Ross <elena.ross@fastai.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Taylor Shaw <taylor@fastai.io>, legal@fastai.io
Date: 2026-11-12T10:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: short testimonial + logo use for pilot announcement

Marissa / Connor — thanks for the detailed response. Our counsel reviewed and attached an annotated PDF with two limited asks: (1) shorten Redwood's approval window to 5 business days for the rendering (we can still review the quote text in parallel), and (2) add a one-sentence carveout allowing FastAI to reference the pilot in investor-facing materials in anonymized form (no logo, no contract values) for up to 6 months.

We annotated inline in the attached and kept the ask narrow. We want to avoid being forced into silent approval for public-facing materials; written approval should be required for press releases.

We are comfortable with the takedown remedy and the 48-hour removal for regulatory/legal concerns. Please review Elena's notes and advise whether Redwood can accept the 5-business-day rendering review period.

Elena Ross
General Counsel, FastAI Labs
Attachment: FastAI_Annotated_Redlines_20261112.pdf (pdf)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Taylor Shaw <taylor@fastai.io>, Elena Ross <elena.ross@fastai.io>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Finalize: limited publicity addendum (next actions)

Team — quick update for records and next steps:

- We can accept FastAI's two asks: 5 business days for rendering approval and the anonymized investor-facing carveout (explicitly no logo/no contract terms). Marissa, please incorporate these two changes into the addendum and prepare a DocuSign packet.
- Connor -> Taylor: we'll include the final quote and logo variant in the packet; Taylor please confirm which logo file (color or mono) and send the final 20–25 word excerpt.
- Target timeline: Marissa will upload the DocuSign by 2026-11-17 COB. If DocuSign is signed, we will proceed to publish the partner page assets within 2 business days of final signature and approval render.

I'll coordinate signatures once Marissa confirms the final text. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
